description: (0.5.0, Draft) Same-identity supersession (RFC-ACDP-0021 §7, amending RFC-ACDP-0003 §3.1 step 3). Behavioral, registry-side; the decision table is the executed kl-001 vector 5.

input.golden: kl-001 (controller did:web:agents.example.com:ci, identity oidc https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com / repo:example/pipeline:ref:refs/heads/main, registry did:web:registry.example.com)

scenarios.name: A — successor attested to another subject
B — successor attested to the same identity
C — successor attested to an org_wide identity
D — successor signed by a DID-document key of the controller
E — non-org-wide keyless successor of a controller-signed body
F — lifecycle event (RFC-ACDP-0013) signed with a keyless key

expected.behavior: Keyless keys do not sign lifecycle events in this version (RFC-ACDP-0021 §6.3). The refusal applies whatever the event's target and the key's identity, org_wide included.
